description: Na₄Mg(BiO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with four equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent BiO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.80 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.59 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.57 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.78 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent BiO₅ square pyramids and corners with four equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.04 Å. There are two inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted BiO₅ square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.60 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.23 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Bi atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Bi atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to three Na and two Bi atoms.
